#465 · Vine Pokémon

Tangrowth

Grass

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Tangrowth is a Grass-type Vine Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 128.6 kg. It evolves from Tangela. Its highest base stat is Defense (125), with a base stat total of 535.
